caption: The drawing depicts two sculpted horse figures positioned on cylindrical platforms against a plain, light beige background. The horse on the left is shown in a three-quarter side view, predominantly dark brown to black in color, featuring a decorated brown saddle with a lighter fur or patterned patch, silver fastenings, and a bridle that extends to the bit of the horse’s mouth. The cylindrical base is dark with reddish-brown bands encircling it. The horse on the right faces directly forward, also dark brown to black in color, and lacks the visible saddle detail seen on the left horse. Its cylindrical base is similar, with dark and reddish-brown bands. Both figures are drawn with attention to light and shadow, giving them a glossy, reflective appearance. The composition spaces the two horses apart on the page with substantial empty background around them. In the lower right corner, there is the small printed text "W.A. Fletcher."
title: Horse on Barrel Bank
